decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1 The proposal would result in an undesirable loss of a retail shop which would adversely affect the remaining retail functions of the parade and would have adverse effects on the environment, residential amenity and highway conditions particularly relating to on street parking contary to Policy S.1.3 of the Councils Unitary Development Plan and S.1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Review.

Condition : 2 - 2 The Development would result in undue noise and disturbance to the amenities of neighbouring residents contary to the provisions of Policies ENV1.1 and ENV1.7 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan and Policies ENV - B.1.1 and ENV - P1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan Review.

Condition : 3 - 3 Adequate parking and loading space is not provided and the resulting conditions of the relevant sections of adjoining highways would be prejudical to the free flow of traffic and conditions of general safety and the amenities of adjoining residential area contary to the provisions of policies ENV1.1 and T.2.5 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan and ENV-B.1.1 and T.1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan Review.

Condition : 4 - 4 The poposed external ducting would be unattractive and detract from the visual amenities of adjoining residents contary to Policies ENV1.1 of the Counci;'s Unitary Development Plan and ENV.B.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan Review.
description: Change of use from retail to restaurant (A3), re-location of rear access to front to first floor flat and installation of new shop front.
